About

Description

Hieronymus Bosch was a Dutch painter from Brabant. He is one of the most notable representatives of the Early Netherlandish painting school. His work, generally oil on oak wood, mainly contains fantastic illustrations of religious concepts and narratives. Wikipedia
Born: 's-Hertogenbosch, Netherlands
Died: August 9, 1516, 's-Hertogenbosch, Netherlands
Periods: Renaissance, Early Netherlandish painting
Known for: Painting
Parents: Anthonius van Aken, Aleid van der Mynnen
Siblings: Goessen van Aken
